vendored: Only upstream files reached by the promoted module builds, plus FTL/GPLv2 license texts; bytes unchanged.
configuration: Upstream default ftoption.h with FT_CONFIG_OPTION_NO_ASSEMBLER defined on the command line (no inline assembly).
version_evidence: Every FreeType-specific string observed in the original font code exists in 2.9 through 2.10.4; 2.8.1 lacks several and 2.11 drops the warping property. 2.9 reproduces the largest set of complete bodies.
limitations: Isolated complete-body matches do not establish the original FreeType revision, configuration, linked data, or a complete library build.
